    YOUR PROJECT DESK
    Edit the starting point
    Changing scope or requests clears previous analysis, decisions, and estimates so nothing stale carries over. This tab holds your work; refresh or close it to clear it.
    

    PRIVATE BY DESIGN
    Meet your local second opinion
    ✳
    ScopeCheck downloads an open-weight model to this browser, then compares your text on your device.
    • About 87 MB of model weights, plus tokenizer and runtime files (about 120 MB total). The first load can take a few minutes.
    • Your scope and requests stay in this tab. Asset hosts receive ordinary download metadata, such as your IP address, but no project text.
    • English text only. AI can miss context and misread scope. These are review suggestions, not legal advice.
    • Downloads may be cached by your browser. Offline operation is not guaranteed. Canceling stops the worker.
    

    BUILT TO BE OPEN
    Small model. Honest boundaries.
    ScopeCheck runs NLI DeBERTa v3 xsmall locally using Xenova’s quantized ONNX weights and Transformers.js 3.8.1 in a Web Worker (WASM).
    The model measures textual entailment, contradiction, and neutrality for every scope/request pair. Its scores are not calibrated probabilities of contractual coverage.
    • “Likely covered” requires strong textual support and safety checks. It is still only a suggestion.
    • “Possible change” requires an explicit quantity flag or high model conflict with restrictive scope wording. It does not mean a fee is owed.
    • Neutral, vague, mixed, instruction-like, or overlong requests need clarification. Unclear scope cannot prove extra work.
    • No silent truncation: pairs over 512 model tokens are not analyzed. Split long clauses carefully and preserve context.
    • Each scope item is evaluated separately. Dependencies across items, pricing, intent, and legal meaning may be missed.
    • The model is trained on general English NLI, not freelance agreements. Displayed scores are heuristic evidence, not professional advice.
    No analytics, accounts, document storage, or inference API. Project data is memory-only. The base model and this source project are Apache-2.0 licensed; the ONNX conversion is attributed separately.
    

    Your work stays here
    ScopeCheck holds project text in this browser tab’s memory. It does not save documents to localStorage, send them to an AI service, or run analytics.
    The app is delivered by its host. After you choose “Download & analyze”, jsDelivr and Hugging Face supply model/runtime files and receive normal asset-request metadata. The browser may cache these assets. Only the model files are cached, not your project.
    Copy and download are actions you choose. A downloaded brief is a local file that you control. Refreshing or closing this tab loses unsaved work, so export a brief first if you need it.
    Browser extensions, shared devices, and the site’s hosting/access controls are outside this app’s privacy boundary. Hosting and access settings are separate from the application. ScopeCheck itself needs no account or API key.
